$$\begin{aligned}\dfrac{-8}{\pi}(7-x)+2x&=0\\\dfrac{-56}{\pi}+\dfrac{8x}{\pi}+2x&=0\\\dfrac{-56}{\pi}+\dfrac{8x}{\pi}+\dfrac{2\pi x}{\pi}&=0\\-56+8x+2\pi x&=0\\2x(4+\pi)&=56\\x&=\dfrac{28}{4+\pi}\end{aligned}$$

$A''=\frac{8}{\pi}+2>0$ for all $x$, concave up

$\therefore x=\dfrac{28}{4+\pi}$ is a minimum stationary point

The combined area is minimum when the length of the two portions are:

$$4x=4\left(\dfrac{28}{4+\pi}\right)=\dfrac{112}{4+\pi}\,m$$

and

$$\begin{aligned}28-4x&=28-\dfrac{112}{4+\pi}\\&=\dfrac{28\pi}{4+\pi}\,m\end{aligned}$$

orphan_solutions.latex:
The $n^{\text{th}}$ term of an arithmetic series is given by

$$T_n=a+(n-1)\times2$$

The 3rd, 6th and 10th terms are

$$T_3=a+4\qquad T_6=a+10\qquad T_{10}=a+18$$

Since $T_3$, $T_6$ and $T_{10}$ are the first three terms of a geometric sequence we have a common ratio. $r$, between the terms.

$$\begin{aligned}\dfrac{T_6}{T_3}&=\dfrac{T_{10}}{T_6}\\\dfrac{a+10}{a+4}&=\dfrac{a+18}{a+10}\\(a+10)^2&=(a+4)(a+18)\\a^2+20a+100&=a^2+22a+72\\28&=2a\\a&=14\end{aligned}$$

So we have

$$r=\dfrac{a+10}{a+4}=\dfrac{24}{18}=\dfrac{4}{3}$$
